item.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green
item.description: Bitcoin ETFs drew $424 million over three days, lifting October net inflows to $111 million despite a hawkish Federal Reserve decision and weaker crypto sentiment.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair
item.description: CFTC chair Mike Selig says autonomous AI agents could challenge financial rules built around human traders, and regulators need to adapt.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police
item.description: Police say at least two cases were reported as early as Sept. 10, nearly a month before the wider incident became public.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
item.description: Traders are pricing in a 78% chance of a December rate hike, while analysts say Treasury yields, the US dollar and upcoming inflation data could determine Bitcoin’s next move.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Canadian ‘crypto king’ case to go to jury as criminal trial winds down
item.description: Aiden Pleterski, facing fraud charges in Canada over his alleged role in a digital asset Ponzi scheme, said that he was innocent at closing.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Sam Bankman-Fried wrote to actor portraying him in Netflix series
item.description: The former FTX CEO remains incarcerated as Irish actor Anthony Boyle portrays him in a series about the downfall of the crypto exchange and his relationship with Caroline Ellison.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks
item.description: The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto PAC spending before midterms possibly obscured after reported FEC hack
item.description: The FEC reported an “electronic filing system outage” on Tuesday as groups are expected to ramp up spending before the US midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Bitcoin price bounce rejected at 50-day trend line ahead of FOMC, earnings
item.description: Bitcoin failed to move past its 50-day simple moving average as market participants awaited the outcome of the FOMC meeting and key tech earnings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users
item.description: The crypto wallet’s new integration offers CFTC-regulated event contracts through Kalshi, as prediction markets face growing legal challenges in the US.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Google Cloud outlines MPC service for institutional Bitcoin custody
item.description: Google Cloud has detailed its preview MPC service for institutional Bitcoin custody as it holds a New York symposium focused on digital asset security.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Cybersecurity’s Black October: How to protect yourself
item.description: Each day brings news of another AI-powered attack, or a newly discovered vulnerability. Here’s what’s happening and how ordinary people can protect themselves online.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: DTCC unit launches tokenization services
item.description: The post-trade market infrastructure provider said the tokenization services will create a “practical path” for tokenized securities adoption.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
item.description: A Euronext spokesperson told Cointelegraph the suspension was due to “operational settlement requirements” and remains in effect until settlement operations are supported by the CSD.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana
item.description: The company’s Hong Kong unit issued six-month notes under its $3 billion program, extending blockchain-based distribution to institutional investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin price eyes $82K as Morgan Stanley strategist says most of correction is over
item.description: Bitcoin sought to rebuild support at $80,000 while Asian and US tech stocks extended a rebound into key corporate earnings releases.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $286 million over two days, narrowing October’s net outflows to $26 million as the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remained neutral.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Coinbase denies systems breach, says vendor exposed customer data
item.description: Coinbase said that an incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed some customers’ contact data, but it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’
item.description: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption to flourish in the US.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach: Report
item.description: The breach impacted its in-house mobile system, used by employees for work and information sharing.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Discord is making public chats searchable on Google: How to opt out
item.description: Discord conversations on large public servers will soon reach audiences far beyond their communities, raising privacy concerns.

item.title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
item.description: VanEck’s new Wealth Builder ETF targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, with a permitted range of 1% to 5%, gaining exposure through a spot Bitcoin ETP.

item.title: Quantum fears already limiting Bitcoin’s growth, Stacks founder says

item.title: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets
item.description: Ripple also expanded its collaboration with BNY on digital asset custody and partnered with C2FO to bring trade finance settlement onto the XRP Ledger.

item.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets

item.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
item.description: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

item.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar

item.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
